news.summary: The Yankees are activating Carlos Rodon for Tuesday's game against the Orioles and have placed starter Max Fried on the 15-day IL because of a left elbow bruise.

news.title: Field of Dreams game averaged 1.66M viewers
news.summary: MLB's first game at the Field of Dreams movie site in four years in Dyersville, Iowa, averaged 1.66M viewers on Netflix on Thursday night.

news.title: MLB unanimously approves $3.9B sale of Padres
news.summary: MLB team owners unanimously approved the sale of the Padres to an investor group led by private equity billionaire José E. Feliciano and his wife and business partner, Kwanza Jones.

news.title: Cubs' Swanson (oblique strain) out at least 4 weeks
news.summary: Cubs shortstop Dansby Swanson will miss at least four weeks because of a left oblique strain, manager Craig Counsell said Monday.
